verdict.rationale: The evidence covers data isolation, dedicated VPC deployment, IP allowlisting, and SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA compliance, but nowhere states an explicit policy on whether customer data is or isn't used to train Unstructured's or third-party AI models. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training-on-customer-data policy, an opt-out/opt-in training control, or any documentation addressing AI model training use of ingested data.
